product_one_liner.value: iVoyant provides enterprise digital-transformation services and products—including AI/data analytics, cloud, integration, and software development—to help organizations modernize and improve operations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes itself as a technology solutions/services provider for enterprise customers.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation and content do not show a pricing page or pricing link; offerings are presented as services/products requiring contact.

named_customers.notes: The case-studies index and a specific case study use anonymous descriptions (e.g. “leading telecom provider”) rather than naming actual customers.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn categorizes iVoyant as 201–500, but Tracxn reports 82 employees as of 2026-09-30; applying the requested bands, the reported count corresponds to 51–100.

hq_location.notes: The company gives an Atlanta, Georgia address and LinkedIn lists Atlanta, Georgia as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Tracxn company profile reports founded in 2014.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index includes multiple technical posts, including coverage of monolith-to-microservices architecture and CI/CD engineering.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer does not provide a public documentation, help-center, or developer-portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Current listed roles include UX/UI Designer Internship and Azure Platform Engineer; none has an AI/ML/data-science title as defined.

model_provider.notes: The reviewed privacy policy does not identify an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy reviewed does not name any of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

last_funding.notes: Tracxn describes iVoyant as unfunded and reports no funding rounds.

raised_18mo.notes: The company is reported as unfunded, so it did not raise a round in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Current roles are UX/UI Designer Internship and Azure Platform Engineer; neither is an SDR, BDR, or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable company blog index has no dates for its newest launch-type posts, and no reliably dated launch announcement within the required window was found.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company lists several leaders, but no sufficiently dated source verifies a C-level or VP-level join/departure during the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Koodisi product page visibly lists Salesforce and HubSpot among supported connectors.
